I am 51 years old and I have farmed since I was a boy. I finished primary school, so I can read the numbers on the fertilizer sack, but I still do what I have seen work with my own eyes. Last season my neighbor put fertilizer on his maize and his cobs were fat, so I will do the same. This plot is only 0.23 hectares, but it is my own land, so I will buy one 50 kilo bag of NPK 20-10-10 from the agro-dealer and spread it here — that comes to about 40 kilos of nitrogen for each hectare. I will plant the seed I kept from last year because hybrid seed is too expensive for such a small piece, and I will pull weeds by hand with my sons. We do not spray chemicals on maize here, and there is no irrigation — we wait for the June rains. My family will work about 20 days on this plot from clearing to harvest, and I will not hire anyone because there is no extra money for wages.
